text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
What a magnificent run!
Victoire Pisa—!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"...――
What an incredible run...!"

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: ...However—

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Somehow, that didn't seem like...
her usual running style, did it...?

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Heh, that final stretch kick—
To think the day would come where I'd view it
objectively from this perspective.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
It appears the anchoring technique worked.
Heh... I'm glad I could be of some help.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After demonstrating his true strength with a brilliant run in the Hopeful Stakes,
Victoire Pisa took a breather and began preparing to head home, when—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Knock knock)

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, so you were watching.
Thank you very much.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
............
Yes. ――That was a magnificent run.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Without any unnecessary tension in her shoulders or arms,
she entered the gate in a completely relaxed, upright posture.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
And that burst of speed on the final straight.
The timing of her acceleration was astonishingly perfect.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: It was wonderful. ...However, that is not the running I know from you.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
That's something you adopted from
Ruler-san and Rose-san, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: Fufu..., that's true.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Today... Ruler-san and Rose-san.
Their presence was right there with me.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The plan I put together for Eishin Flash heading toward the Hopeful Stakes. That was—

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: About my late-stage burst—?

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Rose-san's final kick is truly something special...
Especially when it comes down to a battle,
she seems to draw out even greater strength.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
I think the hint you're looking for
might lie within Rose-san.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
...It's not as if I possess any special knowledge.
It's merely an intuition gained through relentless effort.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
A late-race burst is a spurt made by giving everything your body has.
Knowing your remaining stamina and judging the exact moment
to make your move is of utmost importance.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Therefore,
first on our training menu—

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
May I ask about the "anchoring"
you sometimes mention, Ruler-san...?

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Heh... Disclosing detailed methodology is like showing a card from my hand, but well... this is special treatment.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
It's a simple bit of autosuggestion
I learned alongside Air Groove-san
back when we were at the racing school.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
"The method is simple.
To connect relaxation to movement,
we will consciously perform conditioning. First—"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
"By joining you both, I was able to learn
about each of your strengths."

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
"Thanks to both of you,
we had a wonderful race."

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: "Learning strengths"—

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I see. That's something one could never achieve alone.
A peerless advantage...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: There's no harm in rearranging the training plan we've built up to this point... in fact, it'll be a plus.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: ...Yes.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"Seeing that running,
I cannot help but feel that way."

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
...May I join you again
for joint training?

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Yes, absolutely.
I'll be waiting for you♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Victoire Pisa's plan
rolled smoothly into place yet again.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Case closed—
Or rather, this is where it truly begins, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: There's still plenty to be done in preparation for the next Satsuki Sho.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: If only our class... the four of us could join hands in a circle and aim for greater heights—

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: ...*yaaaawn*...
choice_data_list: Want to sleep for a bit?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It will still be a while before we reach the station nearest the academy.
When prompted, Victoire Pisa obediently closed her eyes.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry.
Then... just a little bit...

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
…………
*inhale*...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Her profile as she falls asleep, accompanied by gentle swaying—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Thanks to the two of you,
we were able to have a wonderful race."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
That's what she said, but...
the truth was just a little bit different.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: *pant, pant, gasp*...!

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
—Yes...
Thank you very much...!

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
"The preparations for the Hopeful Stakes
are complete, aren't they?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: She was originally capable of running well enough to shine completely on her own, without needing the help of the two.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
However, to prove it to Eishin Flash,
I chose to adopt the running style of her contemporary.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
However, if the drawbacks outweigh the benefits,
we must revert everything to the original method.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Under that promise, she dedicated herself to extra training.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Phew, haah, haah—
...Fufu, we really pushed hard today.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, my apologies.
That was the last one, wasn't it?
Thank you very much.
choice_data_list: Thank you for your hard work.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: ...Ah, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: I plan to ask for guidance from Rose-san tonight, would that be all right?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
From what I can tell, there are no concerns with her body.
She was in perfect health during training too, but...
given today's routine, she must be feeling quite exhausted.
choice_data_list: No issues, but please rest if you're feeling unwell.
No issues, but you should take a break if you're struggling.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, thank you very much.
If that is the case, then there is no problem.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
I'm heading out for today.
I feel like I'm so close to getting the hang of it.
The secret to sprinting right through to the end, just like Ms. Rose...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
To an outsider, it would seem like excessive,
unnecessary effort.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"It was an indispensable time—one needed
to connect our circle and ensure no one was left alone..."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
If it is to achieve their ideals,
they would surely see it through, no matter what it takes.
choice_data_list: (...She really didn't utter a single complaint.)

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
...
I'm sorry, I might have slept in too much...

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
...?
Did something happen?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I felt that precisely because it's now,
there was something I needed to convey.
choice_data_list: ...I truly respect the way you live your life.
...I truly respect the way you live your life.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: In just a single year, I had come to understand the sheer strength of her determination all too well.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even if her heart has no need
for a walking cane—
choice_data_list: I want to keep standing right beside your resolve.
I want to stay right beside your resolve forever.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: ...Well—

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
...Those are rare words indeed.
To have you say such a thing to me...

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: ...Understood.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: Please, allow me to accept your resolve.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —The year of battle will soon begin.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The first race of the Classic Triple Crown, the Satsuki Sho...
I want to race through it together with her as well.
